name: Egg Collection
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, I'm finally ready for real samples of dragon eggs!  Here, take this collectronic module.  It's designed to extract a dragon egg and prepare it for transport.  Go back to the Rookery and use the module to collect eggs.

And don't forget to freeze them first, or they might hatch before you can collect them!

When you have enough eggs, bring them to me!
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Wow, you got them! The collectronic module worked! I'm a genius!

Thank you, adventurer. My patron will be very pleased to get these eggs...
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the eggs, adventurer?  My patron heard you were collecting them for me, and is very eager to get his hands on them!

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 52 to 60, 51,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Broodling Essence
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Felnok Steelspring
quests.objectiveText: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Chillwind Horns
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.objectiveText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.
